question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?
answer: The eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW) are: (a) Admission to Supernumerary Seats [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. (b) TFW is granted to 2% of the approved seats of the program, as per merit [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. (c) Students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs 8.00 lakhs per annum will be eligible [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. (d) A valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].

question: What is the maximum parental annual income allowed under AICTE TFW?
